title: Moroccan Honey Fritters
description: A sweet and crispy Moroccan-inspired dessert, made with honey and fried pastry.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, jjajeek, kissed, and Moroccan spices.
Add the honey and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the dough disks for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve warm.
